title: Her son's musicianship and her own talent
summary: Her son plays saxophone and clarinet but gave up; she says she would have learned music.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: And I thought my son was going to be just like him because he's a wonderful saxophonist, and he plays clarinet, too. But I mean, after he got married, it was causing so much confusion with the family. But he's—with his family, that he felt like, well, he'd just give it up and just do something else.
You seem to have a lot of interest in music. There's different people you've mentioned before we had the tape thrown.
But the thing of it is this, I would—I believe that I'm apt enough to have learned it if I had time to learn.
You must have had talent the same as your brother.
You would have had talent. But he always called me a comedian and stuff. I don't know. Really? Did you ever sing or do any— Never. —thing? No. Not publicly. In school, we had a lot of plays.
